expected_contract: recall path should carry route/reaction edges (or bypass) to reach enzymecage forward

scenario: predicted reactions crosswalked into the candidate pool (TEST-03/TEST-04)
minimal_input: one predicted reaction into the pool node
expected_contract: a single stable state key carries predicted->candidate fields losslessly
observed_state_or_error: production test raises KeyError: 'predicted_reactions' / 'candidate_reactions' (ReactionTask -> ReactionTaskG schema drift between producer and consumer)
minimal_suggestion: align the shared state field name/shape between reaction_prediction_node (producer) and enzyme_pool_node (consumer); keep source_tag/rank/score/evidence_hash carriage

scenario: 8 real records aggregated to reviewed hosts (SS9)
expected_contract: aggregation needs >=1 LEGAL_HOST_SOURCES value (UNIPROT_REVIEWED/KEGG_SUPPLEMENT/BACDIVE_OBSERVED) to emit a resolved organism aggregate
observed_state_or_error: C8 emits host_evidence_sources=['UNRESOLVED'] because the reviewed service is closed; aggregate_route routes every step to unresolved_ledger (covered_step_count=0). organism_mapping_node per_enzyme_source_provenance=[]
minimal_suggestion: provide the reviewed host-evidence source (UNIPROT_REVIEWED/KEGG_SUPPLEMENT/BACDIVE_OBSERVED) from the enzyme2organism service, or an equivalent frozen response identity field on EnzymeSourceProvenance

scenario: emit an evidence chain when no reviewed host source is resolvable (SS10)
minimal_input: chain with organism_aggregates from an all-UNRESOLVED route
expected_contract: the schema should have a lawful way to represent a route whose organism aggregates are all unresolved (hostEvidence allows UNRESOLVED but organismAggregate does not)
observed_state_or_error: organism_aggregates left [] (honest); the schema's organismAggregate host_evidence_source enum excludes UNRESOLVED, so no aggregate can be emitted for an unresolved route
minimal_suggestion: define the frozen representation for an unresolved organism aggregate (empty list vs an explicit UNRESOLVED aggregate) so producer and schema agree
